season.name: Winter
season.line: The dark season is holy ground.

movement.name: The Hidden Seed
movement.line: What looks dormant is being kept.

days.t: Seed and harvest shall not cease
x: All the days of the earth, seed and harvest, cold and heat, summer and spring, shall not cease by day or night.
To all things there is a time, and a season for every matter under heaven.
A time of birth, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up what has been planted;

days.t: The seed grows, he knows not how
x: And He was saying, “Thus is The kingdom of God: as a man may cast the seed upon the earth,
and may sleep and rise night and day, and the seed may sprout and grow—he does not know how.
Of itself, the earth bears fruit—first a plant, then an ear, then full grain in the ear.
And when the fruit may offer itself, immediately he sends the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

days.t: Unless a grain of wheat falls
x: Truly, truly, I say to you⁺, unless the grain of wheat, having fallen into the ground, should die, it remains alone; but if it should die, it bears much fruit.

days.t: What you sow must die first
x: You Fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
And what you sow [is] not the body that will be, but you sow a bare grain, if it may be of wheat or of some of the rest.
They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
They went on and wept as they cast their seeds; but they shall surely come with exultation, bringing their sheaves [with them].
